horoscopes.horoscope: Love and business will thrive today. Expect profits and loans to come through. If you’re in love, look forward to a mushy evening, where you will pour your heart out to your beloved. What more do you want from a day?. Get creative in the matters of the heart, says Ganesha. Play with words to convey your feelings to your sweetheart. Be creative while expressing something romantic. Your sweet words will do magic at the core of your better half, says Ganesha. Look forward to remain fit and fine till afternoon. However, during the second half of today, you may probably get puzzled. Hence, avoid taking important decisions on all fronts. Devote some time for meditation to improve your power of concentration. You will be happy with your financial standing. In fact, you may be thinking about long-term financial prospects. You will be able to take the right decisions with respect to money matters. Today’s astral energy will help you remain attentive and focused on your work. However, afternoon clouds of confusion may block your thinking. You may lose confidence as your peers will tend to disagree with your view or control your position, feels Ganesha.

You may come across as headstrong to your co-workers and friends today, feels Ganesha. You are known to be stubborn at times and today will be no exception. You may find it unnecessary to meet the other person halfway, regardless of the truth in it. You will remain busy with work all afternoon. Misunderstandings are on the cards, foresees Ganesha. A bitter exchange of words with your loved one might take place. You may not want to spend time with your sweetheart. However, ignoring him/her may create trouble for you later. Watch your step, warns Ganesha. From morning you shall be overflowing with happiness and enthusiasm. But as the day progresses, your mood may swing downwards and your energy level may also start descending. Have a light and healthy dinner, and just go to bed early today. You are going to stay focused on your personality development and you may also want to spend money in order to look better. You may spend money on creativity, beautification, and grooming foresees Ganesha. A tough day, even for a bull, says Ganesha. You might need more than a few sips of Red Bull to be able to maintain your characteristic vigour at work. You need to be alert in the meeting room while making tough decisions, suggests Ganesha.

Your quest for spiritual enlightenment continues. You may not want go to the Himalayas to acquire what you seek, but take a trip to a nearby yoga centre or surf the Internet for Kama Sutra by Deepak Chopra, provided they are for free! It may help you to connect spiritually to your partner, at least. Your partner may find you in a flirtatious mood but is willing to overlook in case you check out that sexy girl or boy. Your sweetheart knows your emotions are in place. You are likely to be in a funny mood with your partner, feels Ganesha. In the first half of the day, you may feel that things are not going as per your plan. Ganesha feels that due to various tasks lined up today, it will be tough for you to give good output, despite spending good amount of energy. Ganesha feels that the time is good for updating balance-sheets, meeting your chartered accountant and managing your personal bank accounts. Some online deals may draw your attention during the second half of the day. The dawn will find you in a playful mood, distracted at work but after lunch, you’ll feel energetic enough. You will feel confident while giving a speech in the meeting. Be prepared for the important assignments coming your way, foresees Ganesha.

You will take a bold stand to achieve full capacity and efficiency. You will come out with new ideas and strategy, which will prove to be useful and profit-able. Avoid confrontation and keep your cool, says Ganesha. Insecurity in your love life may worry you slightly. You may feel shy to approach someone you are in love. However, Ganesha assures that things will be fine soon. Using sense of humour will help your lover keep in contact, feels Ganesha. You will be in a joyous mood from morning till afternoon. The happiness within yourself shall come to the fore. As a result, you will spread the positive vibes in your workplace and home. People around you shall feel happy, too. Some monetary gains are on the cards today for you today, foresees Ganesha, and advises you to keep a track, and written record, of payments received and yet to be received. You might end up wasting a lot of time, if you rely completely on luck, feels Ganesha. Nevertheless, don’t force yourself to take up important tasks today. Know your calibre. You have to be careful while making important decisions, suggests Ganesha.

A comedy of errors is only funny in hindsight. Anyway, too much practicality is what ruined the world, says Ganesha. So for a change, gear up for an easy and relaxed day. Anything goes today, and having your hair groomed seems to be the best idea you have had in a long time. But amidst all this, do not forget to pay special attention to pending tasks at the workplace. Ganesha foresees you sashaying a new look in the evening!. You need something very rich, royal and luxurious to satisfy your sweetheart. You tend to please your lover through lavish spending. You tend to attract your lover at a royal palace or an exotic location. A candlelit dinner with your darling will rekindle the romance. You would require focus today. Don’t let energy get diverted. Ganesha feels that while this is going to be a very busy day at work or even in life, you will have to just ensure that energy is properly directed. You will be able to communicate well your money matters to others, says Ganesha. You may find these discussions very enlightening & enriching and you may be able to discover new perspectives and ideas. A technical error may get on your nerves at the start of the day. Don’t worry as you will be cautious and alert today. Thanks to your logical thinking. You will be able to solve problems easily and earn appreciation from your boss, feels Ganesha.

You are likely to be the goose mother today – violently protective and intensely reclusive. Intense affairs of the heart will materialise amazingly faster than transporter beams from Star Trek do. Procrastination will finally be slain as Ganesha sees an eventful day in store. Lucky Colour Light Forest Green You may ignore your partner due to professional responsibilities. Love life needs to be handled with care, warns Ganesha. You need to listen to your lover when it comes to matters of the heart. Do not forget to give whatever you have promised to your sweetheart. The day favours mentally laborious tasks. It’s a good day to take practical decisions. Ganesha also feels that this is the right day to note down new ideas. However, second part of the day could disturb your focus says Ganesha. This is a good time to make your financial plans using an excel sheet. There are chances of receiving good news in business or a new assignment in the second half of the day. Luck will play a huge role at work. You will be intelligent enough to investigate something in a detailed manner and come up with the appropriate solution. Ganesha says that it’s the best time to do research and development as celestial energies will empower you with logical powers.

Today promises to be an action-packed day for you at work. So, get ready to take the bull by its horns, says Ganesha. Expect to handle a lot of unknown people and unfamiliar situations at work. Evening might find you making a few trips to the market to buy some provisions. Also, love is in the air, and you are in demand. So, the opposite sex will be queuing up to catch a glimpse of you. Ganesha’s grace showers on lovers today. Lovers or married couples will have a blissful time. You will like to plan something different and surprise your sweetheart. Else traveling to a nearby area will enthrall you. A fun-filled evening will enrich the flavour of romance. You will be all set to advise and guide others today however you will have to ensure that time and energy is not just wasted behind others. Ganesha advises to you is to avoid physically exhaustive tasks during the first half the day. Overall, in financial matters, it’s going to be a mixed day for you. You may require more efforts to make financial gains take place for you. Foreign connections may be helpful, says Ganesha. At work, your concentration power will reach a peak today. You will be target-driven and able to solve complex issues at the snap of a finger. Eventually, your performance will improve by the end of the day. You may win praise from higher authorities, feels Ganesha.

In all probability, backlog is the last word you may like to hear. Professionally, you will remain workaholic for most part of the day. You shall polish off all those files in your ‘In’ tray. The romantic bee will buzz around in the evening and gladden your heart, says Ganesha. A challenging day is ahead on the love front. You will be having an amazing time with your lover, provided you will surprise him/her with the most precious gift. After all, it is a perfect way to express your lover tonight. While in the first half of your day you may feel frustrated because you took up a fruitless task, your second half is very good for doing things like paper-work and communication. You should try to talk to people in the second half. You will be in a mood to fulfill the demands of your family members or those who work with you. You won’t mind, even if you have to spend a bit to make them feel happy. You may loose your concentration at work in the morning. Hence, Ganesha advises you to finish off routine tasks that don’t demand too much brain work. You need to stay tuned to the new updates, feels Ganesha. Your colleagues will support you to understand difficult works.

Find yourself taking up the Thinker’s ponderous posture. Post noon, you may find yourself making plans to rearrange the interior of your home. In the office, your superiors will know your worth and heap appreciation on you, says Ganesha. Clear all the doubts with your loved one as Ganesha feels it’s a fantastic day to propose someone if you are in love. Valuable and useful gifts from your loved one will turn on your romantic mood predicts Ganesha. Go out on a perfect date, suggests Ganesha. During the first half of the day, you should carry out important tasks. You will be able to perform pretty well in all the areas of life in the first half. However, you should just relax in the second half of the day. Ganesha feels that today you will try to maintain very good rapport with your business clients. They can give you good business. Delay in financial gains are seen but patience will surely work wonders. You will be confused about many unfinished projects. You will start thinking about the most important matters that need your immediate attention. However, lack of confidence may slow down your progress at work. As the day advances, you will complete pending tasks.

It’s rare that while you’re engaged in work, slogging to sort out things and prove yourself capable, you simultaneously manage time for the love of your life, and spare some more for recreational activities. Quite a bit of multitasking, but that’s what Ganesha has in store for you today. This apart, you will succeed in suppressing all negative feelings, which will be followed by the realisation that you may not be a very ethical person, but you’re at least a good human being. Ganesha foresees emotional stress in your love life. You may not be able to either listen to your partner. You will need all the supports from your sweetheart to form a harmonious relationship. Take a chill pill and stimulate your romance, advises Ganesha. Flexible approach will help you sail through the day easily. You should not get stuck in one idea. You should avoid physically tough tasks in the second half of the day, else you may face health issues or may also get injured. The day is not good for the purchase of real estate or vehicle so you should postpone such purchases for some time. However, this day is good for having an overview of properties or vehicles. You need to be extra careful while taking decisions today. A decision taken without considering pros and cons may land you in trouble. You may have to change the last minute decision before the day ends. Big decisions, like a job change, should be avoided.

Your ideas may be excellent, says Ganesha, but it’s your diplomacy and charm which will oil the wheels. You are a silver-tongued smoothie, and can even talk people into eating soap! Family and friends will revel in your company. If you are a student, you may get As in all your tests!. Today you will be able to breathe fresh air as your partner will value your much-needed space. Ganesha blesses your love life with equal magnanimity. You will tend to be experimental and express your love in a filmy style, much to the surprise of your loved one. The day is good for mechanical and routine tasks at start but in the second half of the day, you will be able to do things more creatively. Health wise, no major issue is seen. Talking at length to friends will make you feel good. During the second half of the day, you will be able to crack good business deals in the negotiations. So, you should schedule important meetings during the latter half of the day, says Ganesha. You will be cheerful, optimistic, and inventive today and this will reflect in your work. Your creative ideas will fetch the best results for the organisation and you will earn appreciation from higher authorities. Your team will feel happy and relaxed working under you, feels Ganesha.

Your energy levels will be at their peak today, and that, coupled with your extraordinary enthusiasm, will give you the momentum you need to implement your plans, says Ganesha. However, major decisions are still likely to be delayed for some reason or the other. Good news! Only your loved one will give you eternal pleasure. Your partner will be pleased with your compromising attitude. Express everything to your sweetheart and he or she will melt in your words. You will enjoy a splendid evening together, says Ganesha. You are suggested not to ‘over-think’ today. If you keep thinking, you may get confused and may end up feeling frustrated too, as you won’t be able to reach any conclusion. You are suggested to remain low profile at work and avoid rigidity in views. Overall, it is not a one sided day for you from a financial perspective. In other words, you will neither make much gains nor incur expenses. Ganesha feels that it’s a very balanced day for you. You may be in a depressed mood today as you are not happy with something or someone. Hence, you may end up committing mistakes at your workplace. Ganesha advises you to avoid taking up important projects. An evening coffee with colleagues or humorous talk will break the ice a bit, feels Ganesha.
